meta.name: judge-long-distance-military-campaign
meta.description: Use when evaluating the feasibility of a long-distance surprise military attack. Assesses distance risks, intelligence reliability, supply line vulnerabilities, and contingency planning. Based on Qin's failed attack on Zheng as a cautionary example.

copy.tagline: 评估远程军事突袭的可行性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析远程军事行动的风险与可行性。
copy.tagline_en: Assess feasibility of long-distance military surprise attacks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze risks and feasibility of long-range military operations.

howto.what: 评估长途军事突袭的可行性。分析距离风险、情报可靠性、补给线脆弱性和应急计划，最终给出是否进攻的建议。
howto.when: 当你要求评估针对远距离目标的意外军事打击时触发。

say.text: 评估一下对遥远敌国的突袭可行性。
say.note: Claude会按照框架分析风险和条件。

say.text: 分析这个长途进攻计划的风险。
say.note: Claude会指出补给线和情报隐患。

say.text: 如何判断长途突袭是否靠谱？
say.note: Claude会列出警告信号和决策要点。

howto.what_en: Evaluate the feasibility of a long-distance surprise military attack. Assess risks including distance, intelligence reliability, supply line vulnerabilities, and contingency planning. Produces a recommendation or risk assessment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to assess the feasibility of a long-distance surprise military attack, especially against a distant target.

say_en.text: Assess the feasibility of a surprise attack on a distant enemy.
say_en.note: Claude will apply the framework to analyze risks and conditions.

say_en.text: Analyze the risks of this long-distance offensive plan.
say_en.note: Claude will highlight supply line and intelligence issues.

say_en.text: How to judge if a long-distance surprise attack is viable?
say_en.note: Claude will list warning signs and decision points.
